libuvc 0.0.8 in SuperDRO

Source: https://github.com/libuvc/libuvc
Tag: v0.0.8
Commit: 4e9fc773914377ec0bcf2f31621f56da5a0fa09f
License: BSD 3-clause license (LICENSE.txt)

This directory has the files of the tag that the Android build needs. The
build does not use libjpeg, so src/frame-mjpeg.c is not here. The JNI code
of SuperDRO and these files make libsuperdro_uvc.so.

SUPERDRO_CHANGES.txt lists the changes of SuperDRO to these files.
